import os, re, json, glob, zipfile, io
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

ROOT = "/online1/ycsc_chenkh/hitici_07/deepseek-harness/attached_files/task_9"

records = []
for path in sorted(glob.glob(ROOT + "/**/*", recursive=True)):
    if not os.path.isfile(path) or path.endswith(".xlsx"):
        continue
    rel = os.path.relpath(path, ROOT)
    text = open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
    # normalize html entities/xml escaping for uniform grep
    t = text.replace("&", "&").replace("'", "'").replace(""", '"')

    def g(pattern, flags=re.I|re.S):
        m = re.search(pattern, t, flags)
        return " ".join(m.group(1).split()) if m else ""

    rec = {}
    rec["file"] = rel
    rec["record"] = g(r"(CB-DOC-\d{3}-\d{3})")
    rec["folder"] = rel.split("/")[0]
    rec["role"] = g(r"EVIDENCE ROLE:\s*(\S+)|Evidence role\s*\|\s*(\S+)").replace("|","").strip()
    if not rec["role"]:
        m = re.search(r'evidence[_ ]role"?\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"', t, re.I)
        rec["role"] = m.group(1) if m else ""
    rec["issue"] = g(r"This record concerns\s+(.+?)\s+within\s+Project Daybreak")
    rec["issue_title"] = g(r"legal name Helios Forge, Inc\. — (.+?) record")
    rec["pk"] = g(r"PORTFOLIO KEY:\s*(\S+)") or g(r"Portfolio key\s*\|?\s*(CBP-[\d-]+)")
    rec["entities"] = sorted(set(re.findall(r"ENT-\d+-\d+", t)))
    rec["rev_ref"] = g(r"Referenced revision\s*\|?\s*(REV-[\d.]+)")
    rec["rev_cur"] = g(r"Current revision\s*\|?\s*(REV-[\d.]+)")
    rec["matter_control"] = g(r"matter-level control is:?\s*(.+?)\.?(?:\s*$|\n)")
    # the operative/dispositive statement (contains CB-MA-2401-X### reference)
    ops = re.findall(r"([^.]*CB-MA-2401-[A-Z]\d+[^.]*\.)", t)
    rec["operative"] = ops[:4]
    rec["dates"] = sorted(set(re.findall(r"\b20(?:2[4-9])-\d{2}-\d{2}\b", t)))
    # crosswalk statement
    rec["crosswalk"] = g(r"(Crosswalk revision[^.]+\.)")
    rec["collision"] = "collision" in t.lower() or "disagree" in t.lower()
    records.append(rec)

# index by issue title
from collections import defaultdict
by_issue = defaultdict(list)
for r in records:
    key = r["issue"] or r["issue_title"] or "?"
    by_issue[key].append(r)

print("=== ISSUES ===")
for k, v in sorted(by_issue.items()):
    roles = sorted(set(x["role"] for x in v))

        print(f"  {x['file']:55s} rec={x['record']} role={x['role']:22s} pk={x['pk']:14s} ents={','.join(x['entities'])}")

This record concerns change-of-control consent within Project Daybreak battery acquisition. A carve-out manufacturer owns cathode tooling in Nevada while its largest automaker customer can terminate upon an indirect change of control. The record addresses one part of the broader question: Match the cathode-tooling records and automaker consent history to the exact acquired entity.

Native record

change-of-control consent approval must come from Talia Brooks under CB-MA-2401-R473. The referenced and current revision are both REV-2025.4. The matter-level control is: The executed purchase terms and the latest consent schedule control; seller summaries do not.

Reliance limits

This file supplies operative authority evidence for CBP-001-11. It does not decide legal effect, select among candidate responses, resolve another system's entity identity, or establish that its cited revision is controlling.
